headlines.title: Coronavirus Tests Limits of Central Bank Firepower
headlines.abstract: Investors are looking to the Federal Reserve and its peers as markets swoon and infections rise. They’re short on ammunition.

headlines.title: Reserve Bank of Australia cuts interest rates to record low 0.5% amid coronavirus concerns
Fed Official Says Central Bankers Are Aligned in Coronavirus Response
headlines.abstract: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York president, John C. Williams, said central banks were working in tandem to tackle the global economic threat.

headlines.title: Prepare for the coronavirus global recession
